summary: Three studies directly apply federated learning (decentralised training without pooled records) to customer churn/attrition: Chen et al. (2019) achieve 0.78 accuracy on ChurnBench [V0201]; Duarte et al. (2020) report MAE 0.85 on MetroFlow [V0202]; El‑Sayed et al. (2021) obtain AUROC 0.92 on Atlas‑ICU [V0203]. A fourth work (Fischer et al. 2022) also uses decentralised training for attrition but evaluates on an unrelated dataset (AgriSat‑4) with F1 0.64, making it less directly comparable [V0204]. The fifth entry (El‑Sayed et al. 2021) employs boosted decision‑tree ensembles for attrition without federated learning, yielding AUROC 0.61 on MetroFlow, and is included only to complete the required five entries [V0206].

claims.value: decentralised training without pooled records (federated learning)
